title: Constant sheaf local factors and zeta L-series
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$ and $E=\Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] with $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, equipped with the normalized compatible constant datum of [lem-zl-constant-weil-datum]. For every closed point $y$ of $Y_0$, of degree $d_y=[\kappa(y):k_0]$, the one-circuit local Frobenius on the constant stalk $E$ in degree zero is the identity in both of its forms: the operator $F_y$ of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] for the canonical Weil structure $(E_Y,\theta_E)$, and the rationalization to $E$ of the compatible finite-level stalk operators $F_{x,d_y}$ of [def-trf-frobenius-operators] for the levels $((A_n)_Y,\varphi_n)$ of that datum, where $x\in Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^{d_y}})$ is a point with image $y$ (given by a $k_0$-embedding $\kappa(y)\hookrightarrow\mathbf F_{q^{d_y}}$); each finite-level operator $F_{x,d_y}$ is the identity of the stalk $A_n$. Hence, for either operator, the local determinant factor is $\det(1-T^{d_y}F_y\mid E)=1-T^{d_y}$. The Euler product defining the constant sheaf's $L$-series, namely $\prod_y\det(1-T^{d_y}F_y\mid E)^{-1}$, is coefficientwise locally finite and equals the coefficientwise image of $Z(Y_0,T)$ [sk-def-zeta] under $\iota:\Q\hookrightarrow E$ [def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map].
